name: Customer Support Desk
permissionsNotice: Bot Cabinet generates plans and packages. Hermes Desktop settings and connected-service permissions are applied by you. Passports are checklists, not locks.

members.name: Chief of Staff
members.responsibility: Classify each incoming request and route it to the right path.
requestedCapabilities: Read-only access to approved planning documents and calendar information
approvalActions: Ask before changing a calendar, task, or shared record
A leader sets priorities, assigns people, and approves commitments and deadlines
members.firstTest: Use sample updates from two projects to produce a one-page priority brief and a decision log for review.

members.name: Researcher
members.responsibility: Find the approved policy or customer record needed for the case.
requestedCapabilities: Read-only document access when I provide files
approvalActions: A person makes legal, medical, financial, and policy decisions
members.firstTest: Answer one narrow question using at least three approved sources and identify any unresolved conflict.

members.name: Writer
members.responsibility: Draft a concise response using confirmed information.
requestedCapabilities: Optional web access for checking supplied links
approvalActions: A person approves factual claims and final wording
members.firstTest: Draft a 500-word article from one approved outline and three supplied sources.

members.name: Editor
members.responsibility: Check each reply for tone, accuracy, and whether it needs escalation.
requestedCapabilities: Optional web access for checking supplied links
members.firstTest: Edit a two-page memo and explain the five most important changes.

handoffOrder.action: Classify urgency, topic, customer, and required records.
Find the approved answer and mark missing information.
Prepare the reply or escalation record.
Approve, revise, or route the response.

approvalActions: Issue a refund, credit, replacement, or account change
Handle a legal, safety, or privacy issue
